facility.name: Dreamy Days Academy LLC
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,After School Care,Snacks Provided

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 1340 SOUTH ST, BEAUMONT, TX, 77701

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: I observed Clorox wipes accessible to children in the pre-school classroom and on the diaper changing table in the infant room.     This was corrected when the wipes were moved to a location inaccessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One caregiver was observed leaving the infant classroom with 7 infants with a specified age group of 12-17 months old, leaving only one caregiver to care for the children.     This was corrected when the caregiver returned to the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Two electrical outlets were observed without outlet covers in the toddler room.     This was corrected when the director placed covers on the electrical outlets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant Handwashing - Individual Cloth: I observed the caregiver not wash an infant's hands after their diaper got changed.   This was corrected when the inspector asked the caregiver to wash the infant's hands with a wipe.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Handwashing - Individual Cloth (26 TAC §746.3421(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: I observed children in the infant room watching a video on the tablet.    This was corrected when the caregiver faced the tablet face down.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Poisonous Plants Inaccessible to Children: Mushrooms were observed on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Poisonous Plants Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(6))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver was observed on camera not washing their hands after changing an infants diaper
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Two out of four caregivers did not have a  pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking available for review
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: I observed the caregiver not wash a child's hand after there diaper got changed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver with a pending background check was observed caring for children.     This was corrected during the inspection when I observed  the caregiver leave.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Two out of four caregivers did not have a certificate in CPR available for review
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Two infants under the age of two were observed standing inside of there cribs watching mickey mouse on the tablet. The tablet was sitting side ways on the teachers desk and being prompt up by a yellow basket.     This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver removed the tablet and took the two infants out of the crib to explore.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: An infant caregiver was observed on camera  popping a child on the hands three times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): Four out of four staff members did not have a signed affidavit available for review
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: Six out of six children were missing a date of admission.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: The director was the only caregiver in the classroom caring for 14 toddlers. The youngest child was 2 and the oldest child was 3 with the specified age group being 2.     This was corrected during the inspection when another caregiver came to help in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: The infant caregiver was observed on camera  walking out of the infant classroom and into the next classroom and having a conversation with the toddler teacher for over a minute.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: The list of children being transported was not completed for each day the children were transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: The operation's van did not have the fire extinguisher secured in the passenger compartment. A picture was taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection - Inspection not available, you must obtain documentation stating inspection not available: Current documenation from the health department was not available stating a health inspection is not available. This was corrected at the inspection when the sanitation official sent the required documentation needed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection - Inspection not available, you must obtain documentation stating inspection not available (26 TAC §746.3401(c)(1))
